title: Space
description: Sets consistent spacing between inline or stacked elements.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Wrap elements in Space to separate them with a medium (16px) gap.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Preset sizes small (8px), medium (16px) and large (24px), or any number of pixels.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: align positions items on the cross axis; justify distributes them on the main axis (use block to give it room).

wrap.title: Wrap
wrap.description: Let items wrap onto multiple lines when the container is too narrow.

split.title: Separator
split.description: Render a separator, such as a vertical Divider, between items.

compact-and-block.title: Compact and block
compact-and-block.description: compact halves the preset gap; block stretches the container to the full width.

SpaceProps.align: Alignment of the items on the cross axis
SpaceProps.justify: Alignment of the items on the main axis
SpaceProps.size: Gap between items: a preset (small = 8px, medium = 16px, large = 24px) or a number of pixels
SpaceProps.wrap: Wraps items onto multiple lines (horizontal only)
SpaceProps.compact: Compact mode: halves the preset gap
SpaceProps.block: Stretches the container to the full width of its parent
